summary: Documentation-only implementation-planning phase producing the definitive plan for Phase 120E: a deterministic, read-only Repository Knowledge Snapshot generator. Defines docs/PHASE_120_REPOSITORY_KNOWLEDGE_SNAPSHOT_PROTOTYPE_PLAN.md, reaffirming all ten implementation boundaries from 120A-120C (read-only, deterministic, observe-only, no execution, no repository/runtime mutation, no AI inference, no network access, no Advisory/Decision Evaluation integration). Defines planned conceptual inputs, an eleven-stage logical extraction pipeline (an implementation-planning elaboration of 120B's ten frozen stages, not a contract amendment), a ten-component plan (responsibility/inputs/outputs/boundaries, no code specified), a source attribution plan, unknown-handling and limitation plans, a verification plan for 120F, and a fail-closed failure plan. Makes the persistence-location decision 120B deferred to this phase: selects .pcae/repository-intelligence/ as the planned output location, with rationale against the other two 120A candidates. Lists 120E's expected deliverables and eleven measurable acceptance criteria, documents four implementation risks with mitigations, explicitly defers the query layer, Advisory consumption, change impact prototype, graph traversal, and execution planning/capability, and carries forward the same three known inherited, non-blocking tooling/reporting issues without repairing them. No schema, source, or test file was changed; no implementation occurred.
tests_added_or_updated: None. 120D was a documentation-only planning phase and did not add automated tests.
implementation_planning_summary: Defines exactly how Phase 120E will implement a deterministic, read-only Repository Knowledge Snapshot generator, subject to every boundary from 120A, every rule frozen in 120B, and every finding verified in 120C.
component_responsibility_summary: Source Inventory Component - enumerate allowed input sources present at the snapshotted commit
Attribution Component - assign deterministic Source Attribution Records before extraction
Extraction Component - apply deterministic, non-inferential extraction to attributed sources
Normalization Component - normalize candidate knowledge without altering substantive meaning or attribution
Assembly Component - assemble normalized knowledge into the Repository Knowledge Snapshot shape
Schema Alignment Component - align the assembled structure against the frozen schema
Limitation/Unknown Capture Component - populate unknowns, snapshot_limitations, and per-record limitations honestly
Boundary Attachment Component - attach boundary_disclosures, disclaimers, and the family-specific disclaimer const verbatim
Persistence Component - write the completed snapshot through the governed PCAE lifecycle only
Verification/Reporting Component - verify the persisted snapshot against the 120F verification agenda
persistence_location_decision: Selected .pcae/repository-intelligence/ as the planned (not yet implemented) output location, resolving the persistence-location decision 120B Section 13 deferred to this phase. Rejected artifacts/repository-intelligence/ and reports/repository-intelligence/ as introducing unnecessary new top-level conventions or risking conflation with .pcae/phase-reports/.
acceptance_criteria_for_120e: Exactly one Repository Knowledge Snapshot artifact generated per run, no other artifact family produced
Generated artifact validates structurally against the frozen schema and its shared components
Every content-bearing record carries a valid source_attribution locator
Re-running the generator against the same commit produces byte-for-byte identical output except approved metadata
All nine boundary_disclosures fields and all six disclaimer consts present, verbatim, unmodified
unknowns and snapshot_limitations populated wherever generator coverage has bounds
No repository file outside the artifact's own governed persistence write was modified
No execution, shell mediation beyond governed commands, AI provider invocation, external API call, or network access occurred
No Advisory or Decision Evaluation subsystem invoked, mutated, or replaced
Artifact persisted only through the governed PCAE lifecycle, origin/main..HEAD returned to 0
risks_documented: Extraction ambiguity for architectural entities - mitigated via fail-closed representation in both applicable $defs or an unknowns entry
Determinism drift from git/filesystem ordering - mitigated via explicit stable-key sorting before assembly
Persistence location conflicts with the architecture zone system (.pcae/ is unclassified) - mitigated via the same --allowed-file task-contract pattern used throughout 119
Schema evolution mismatch between 120D planning time and 120E implementation time - mitigated by requiring 120E to re-verify the schema's current required fields and $defs at implementation time
